listings.Job Description: We are looking for an intern to join our Dubai team. You should be enrolled in a local university and can work at least 20 hours a week. Your main responsibilities include: Get onboarding to Trendyol Culture! Onboard the seller’s team on order processing, reports, listing management, etc. Selection expansion through working with the seller to complete listing templates. Daily tracking of returns for assigned sellers to create a flawless experience for our sellers. Provide weekly feedback to sellers for operational excellence.
listings.Job Requirements: Available to work full time. You are a senior student or new graduate of a university Bachelor's/Master's Degree program majoring in Business Management or Engineering. Advanced level of English. Good team player with strong learning agility, result orientation, and data literacy. Ability to navigate and implement ideas. Demonstrated ability to be self-motivated.
